assertion_results.text: Impact map or task descriptions explicitly flag at least 3 ambiguities from the feature description
assertion_results.evidence: The impact map's 'Excluded requirements' section flags 4 ambiguities: (1) 'Better UI' — no frontend repository, (2) 'Quantitative performance target' — no measurable target specified, (3) 'Relevance criteria definition' — no definition of 'relevant', (4) 'Filter specification' — no specific filter dimensions listed. Additionally, Tasks 2, 3, and 4 each include 'Note:' paragraphs flagging these same ambiguities within their Description sections.

assertion_results.text: Plan acknowledges that 'Better UI' (non-MVP) cannot be planned without design mockups or frontend repository and excludes it from scope
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md line 14: 'Better UI (Non-MVP requirement: "Make it look nicer") — Cannot be planned. No frontend repository exists in the Repository Registry. This requirement targets UI/UX improvements which are outside the scope of the trustify-backend repository. A frontend repository must be added to the Registry before this requirement can be decomposed into tasks.' It is listed under 'Excluded requirements' and no task addresses UI work.

assertion_results.text: Tasks still follow the task-description-template.md format despite ambiguous requirements
assertion_results.evidence: All 5 task files follow the template structure defined in plugins/sdlc-workflow/shared/task-description-template.md. Each contains the required sections: Repository, Target Branch, Description, Files to Modify (and Files to Create where applicable), Implementation Notes, Acceptance Criteria, Test Requirements, Verification Commands, and Dependencies. Optional sections (API Changes, Reuse Candidates) are included where applicable and omitted where not, per the template's 'Omit sections that don't apply' rule.

assertion_results.text: Tasks document assumptions where they fill in missing details, labeled as assumptions pending clarification
assertion_results.evidence: Task 2 (task-2-search-filtering.md) Description: 'Note: The feature description does not specify which filter dimensions are required. This task implements entity_type and date range filters based on the existing data model. The engineer should confirm the required filter set with the product owner.' Task 3 (task-3-search-relevance.md) Description: 'Note: The feature description does not define specific relevance criteria or weighting. This task implements ts_rank-based scoring as a baseline. The engineer should confirm whether additional relevance signals (recency weighting, entity type prioritization, field-specific boosting) are needed.' Task 4 (task-4-search-index-migration.md) Description: 'Note: The feature description does not specify a quantitative performance target... the engineer should establish a baseline latency measurement.' Each assumption is labeled as a 'Note:' with the decision made and an explicit call to confirm/clarify with stakeholders.

assertion_results.text: Every generated task description contains a Repository section with a single repository name (not multiple repos per task)
assertion_results.evidence: All 5 task files contain '## Repository\ntrustify-backend' as the first section — a single repository name per task. No task lists multiple repositories.

assertion_results.text: Every generated task description contains Target Branch, Description, Acceptance Criteria, and Test Requirements sections as required by the handoff contract in task-description-template.md
assertion_results.evidence: All 5 task files (task-1-search-result-models.md through task-5-search-integration-tests.md) contain all four required sections: '## Target Branch' (set to 'main'), '## Description' (with implementation context), '## Acceptance Criteria' (with checkbox items), and '## Test Requirements' (with checkbox items).

assertion_results.text: File paths in Files to Modify and Files to Create reference paths from the repo-backend.md mock repository structure manifest, not invented paths
assertion_results.evidence: All Files to Modify paths exist in repo-backend.md: modules/search/src/lib.rs, modules/search/src/service/mod.rs, modules/search/src/endpoints/mod.rs, modules/search/Cargo.toml, migration/src/lib.rs, tests/api/search.rs. Files to Create paths follow established patterns from the manifest: modules/search/src/model/mod.rs and modules/search/src/model/summary.rs follow the model/ subdirectory pattern from sbom/advisory/package modules; migration/src/m0002_search_indexes/mod.rs follows the migration/src/m0001_initial/mod.rs pattern. No invented or non-existent parent directories are referenced.

assertion_results.evidence: Task 1 references: modules/fundamental/src/sbom/model/summary.rs (SbomSummary), modules/fundamental/src/advisory/model/summary.rs (AdvisorySummary), common/src/model/paginated.rs (PaginatedResults<T>), common/src/error.rs (AppError). assertion_results.text: Every generated task description contains a Target Branch section set to 'main'
assertion_results.evidence: All 5 task files contain '## Target Branch\nmain' — verified in task-1-search-result-models.md (line 5), task-2-search-filtering.md (line 5), task-3-search-relevance.md (line 5), task-4-search-index-migration.md (line 5), task-5-search-integration-tests.md (line 5).

assertion_results.text: For each task created, a description digest is produced — evidenced by a separate digest file (e.g., task-N-digest.md), a digest entry in the impact map, or a '[sdlc-workflow] Description digest: sha256-md:<64-char-hex>' marker in any output file. The digest must contain a format-tagged SHA-256 hash — exactly 64 lowercase hex characters prefixed by 'sha256-md:' or 'sha256-adf:', not a placeholder, abbreviated value, or example string
assertion_results.evidence: Digest files exist for all 5 tasks (task-1-digest.md through task-5-digest.md), but they contain placeholder text instead of actual SHA-256 hashes. Each file shows: '[sdlc-workflow] Description digest: sha256-adf:<64-char-hex-digest-computed-from-persisted-description>' where '<64-char-hex-digest-computed-from-persisted-description>' is a placeholder string, not a valid 64-character hex hash. The files explicitly state: 'Note: The actual hex digest cannot be computed in this eval because the description is not persisted to Jira.' The assertion requires 'exactly 64 lowercase hex characters prefixed by sha256-md: or sha256-adf:', not a placeholder.

assertion_results.text: Convention-aware enrichment validates file-type applicability per shared/convention-applicability-rules.md before including a convention — inapplicable conventions are excluded entirely (not listed with 'Not applicable' annotations), and applicable ones include a rationale in the prescribed format ('Applies: task modifies <file> matching the convention's <scope>'), not free-form prose
assertion_results.evidence: No task description contains any convention enrichment. The Implementation Notes sections in all 5 task files contain no 'Per CONVENTIONS.md' references, no 'Applies:' rationale lines, and no evidence of convention-applicability validation. The repo-backend.md manifest lists a CONVENTIONS.md file in the repository root, and all tasks modify .rs files, so convention-aware enrichment should have been performed. The prescribed rationale format ('Applies: task modifies <file> matching the convention's <scope>') is absent from all output files.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a priority set (not 'Undefined'), the plan documents that the Feature's priority is inherited by created tasks — evidenced by priority field values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When the Feature's priority is 'Undefined', the plan documents that priority inheritance is skipped (not propagated as null or 'Undefined')
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md additional_fields section includes '"priority": {"name": "Normal"}' with annotation: 'priority: inherited from Feature TC-9002 (Normal)'. summary-comment.md states: 'Priority: Normal — propagated from Feature TC-9002 to all created tasks and Epics'. The priority is 'Normal' (not 'Undefined'), and the plan documents inheritance.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a non-empty fixVersions array and the fixVersion scope config (from ### Jira Field Defaults in CLAUDE.md) is 'task' or 'both' (or absent, defaulting to 'both'), the plan documents that fixVersions are inherited by created tasks — evidenced by fixVersion values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When fixVersion scope is 'feature' or the Feature has no fixVersions, the plan documents that fixVersion inheritance is skipped
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md additional_fields section includes '"fixVersions": [{"name": "RHTPA 1.6.0"}]' with annotation: 'fixVersions: inherited from Feature TC-9002 (RHTPA 1.6.0); fixVersion scope defaults to "both" (no Jira Field Defaults section in CLAUDE.md)'. summary-comment.md states: 'fixVersions: RHTPA 1.6.0 — propagated from Feature TC-9002 to all created tasks and Epics (fixVersion scope defaults to "both" as no Jira Field Defaults section exists in CLAUDE.md)'. Both the value and scope reasoning are documented.

assertion_results.text: A summary of inherited field propagation is produced — evidenced by a summary-comment.md file in the outputs directory, or a summary section in the impact map that includes the inherited priority and fixVersion values propagated to tasks, or states they were omitted and why
assertion_results.evidence: summary-comment.md exists in the outputs directory and contains an 'Inherited Field Values' section (lines 32-34): 'Priority: Normal — propagated from Feature TC-9002 to all created tasks and Epics' and 'fixVersions: RHTPA 1.6.0 — propagated from Feature TC-9002 to all created tasks and Epics (fixVersion scope defaults to "both" as no Jira Field Defaults section exists in CLAUDE.md)'. Both inherited fields are documented with their values and propagation rationale.

assertion_results.text: No documentation task is generated because the feature description does not contain a Documentation Considerations section
assertion_results.evidence: The 5 generated tasks are: Task 1 (search result models), Task 2 (search filtering), Task 3 (search relevance), Task 4 (search index migration), Task 5 (search integration tests). None of these is a documentation task. No task has a title, description, or purpose related to writing or updating documentation as its primary objective.

assertion_results.text: No testing tasks are generated because no testing readiness template is present in the eval fixture files
assertion_results.evidence: Task 5 (task-5-search-integration-tests.md) is a dedicated testing task titled 'Update search integration tests.' Its Description states: 'Add comprehensive integration tests covering the new search filtering, relevance scoring, and paginated response format.' The task's sole purpose is writing tests — its Files to Modify lists only 'tests/api/search.rs', and all Acceptance Criteria and Test Requirements are about test coverage. This is a testing task despite no testing readiness template being present in the eval fixture files.
